svg.aria-label: How one item becomes a pull request: you write the item; the strong model writes a spec; the cheap model implements and commits; programs run the checks, the scope check and the integrity scan; the strong model reviews and can send one fix round; on a clean checkout programs repeat the checks and the red-green test while an auditor drives the change in its own session; the evidence card is written; you approve the merge.

svg.text: Any step can stop the item with a reason: blocked, or draft when its rounds are spent. Nothing is pushed or merged for you.
